::: {#def-intervention .theorem}
## Intervention equation

A deterministic function $h_{\mathbf V_j}$ that returns a value in the range of [covariate](#def-covariate) $\mathbf V_j$ from the covariates preceding $\mathbf V_j$ in a [topological order](#def-dag) of the [NPSEM](#def-npsem):

$$
h_{\mathbf V_j} : \mathcal{R}(\mathbf V_1) \times \dots \times \mathcal{R}(\mathbf V_{j-1}) \to \mathcal{R}(\mathbf V_j),
$$

where $\mathcal{R}(\mathbf V)$ is the range of $\mathbf V$. The arguments are measured variables; the error terms $\mathbf U_{\mathbf V_j}$ are not among them.
:::
